mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_milestones ( contract_id, step_order, milestone_name, work_scope, amount, due_date, status ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{step}, #{title}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{dueDate}, 'WAITING' )
